invariants.rationale: Prevent NullPointerException when passed to parseRegionName.

meta.value: String method parseRegionName(name) expects non-null input

invariants.rationale: Empty string region names are typically invalid for atlas images.

meta.value: Region names are generally non-empty in image resource loaders.

invariants.rationale: Region names consisting of only whitespace are likely unintended.

meta.value: Unexpected whitespace is usually stripped from valid resource names.

invariants.rationale: Fragment identifiers may not be allowed before parsing region name.

meta.value: Region name fragments may be stripped by parseRegionName.

invariants.rationale: Region names are often expected to start with standard identifier characters.

meta.value: Valid region names often start with Java identifier characters.
